note: Curated exact figures for Ember's figure_lookup tool. Every figure names the knowledge-base document it was taken from so answers can cite it. Values are keyed by year; a question without a year receives the latest year listed. Update this file by hand when the source documents change; fetch_figures.py writes its LLM extraction to annual-figures.extracted.json for comparison only.
